title: beat_refiner downbeat over-density: 4/4 misread as 2/4 breaks player
description: Backfill v2 over-densified downbeats on subset of 7,967 applied songs (model thinks 4/4 is 2/4, halves bar duration). chord_splitter trusts downbeats blindly, makes cards too short. player auto_split forces 4 dots evenly across short cards = 2x/4x apparent dot speed. Also player auto_split bypasses manual BPM override (regression from chord_splitter commit). Fix: (1) phase1_refine gate rejects when beats_per_bar drops to ~2 from ~4, (2) chord_splitter sanity check on bar/bpm consistency, (3) player auto_split honors bpmMult override, (4) selective .bak restore for affected songs (preserve ~6.5-7.5k legit improvements). Examples: Abyss Levoire Combat 2 (beats_per_bar 4->2), user-reported.
close_reason: 3-layer fix shipped (commit 4db2660): phase1_refine bpb gate, chord_splitter sanity check, player auto_split honors override + sanity. Selective restore (commit pending) reverted 2,588 of 7,967 over-densified songs. Net: 5,379 legit refinements kept.

title: Re-run beat_refiner backfill after OOM crash

Need to: (1) verify fix via smoke test, (2) re-run with workers=4 + --force to re-process the partial 5450 records, (3) commit fix + push.
close_reason: backfill v2 complete: 78,276 tasks, 7,967 applied (median +0.037 align gain), 67,693 no-op, 2,616 no-audio, 0 errors, 7.74h elapsed. Fix (commit 1852672) survived production-scale spawn race.

title: PC startup-delayed batch beat_this for new songs → V:\
description: NUC has no CUDA. PC needs an automated batch that, 10 min after PC startup, scans V:\data\chords for entries lacking beats_source=='beat_this' and runs beat_this on them with <=3 GPU workers, writing results back to V:\data\chords (sharded). Existing migrate_add_beats_via_beat_this.py has the per-song logic; need: (a) parallel ProcessPoolExecutor wrapper, (b) .bat with 10-min timeout + BELOW_NORMAL priority, (c) Windows Startup folder shortcut path documented, (d) rolling log under data/logs/. Coverage: new songs only (idempotent skip via existing beats_source check). Madmom stays NUC on-demand (already wired).
close_reason: Shipped: scripts/batch_beat_this_pc.py + batch_beat_this_pc_startup.bat. Smoke-tested filter (78k JSONs in ~58s) and per-song flow on V:\data\chords. Awaiting user to drop shortcut into shell:startup.
